principle: GPU returns clean, separated, named stems. It never mixes, never narrates, never grades. CPU does all of that.

gpu_outputs.video: render/ep01/shots/<SHOT>.mp4  h264, yuv420p, 24fps, 480x864, no audio track required
gpu_outputs.video_notes: one file per shot. No concatenation on GPU. No text. No grade. Native colour only.
gpu_outputs.music: render/ep01/music/<THEME>_s<SEED>.wav  48 kHz, 24-bit, NO compression, NO limiter, headroom >= 6 dB
gpu_outputs.music_notes: raw stems. CPU applies duck, EQ, limiter and loudness.
gpu_outputs.meta: render/ep01/shots/<SHOT>.json  {frames, fps, seconds, seed, graph, ref_images_used, gpu, sec}
gpu_outputs.checksums: render/ep01/SHA256SUMS  so CPU can verify nothing arrived corrupt

cpu_does: music bed mixing, ducking, loudnorm -16 LUFS

format_rules.video: mp4 / h264 / yuv420p / 24 fps / fixed 480x864 / keyframe every 24 frames
format_rules.audio_out: final mix 48 kHz stereo, -16 LUFS integrated, true peak -1.5 dBTP
format_rules.naming: <EP>_<SHOT>_<GRAPH>_<SEED>.mp4  - no spaces, no unicode, so ffmpeg globs work
format_rules.no_gpu_mixing: if a GPU run mixes or narrates, it is a defect

acceptance.shot: exists, decodes with ffprobe, frames match the spec, no black frames, duration within 0.2s of spec
acceptance.music: decodes, 48 kHz, peak <= -6 dBFS, not silent
acceptance.total: CPU refuses to assemble if any shot fails acceptance
